qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the seats in this BMW E30 manual?
What is the procedure reference for front seat removal and installation?
qa_pairs.answer: 52 10 000 - Front seat remove and install, which can be found on page 52-101.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find the procedure for replacing seat rails on the front seat?
qa_pairs.answer: Seat rails (outer or inner) on front seat remove and install or replace is procedure 100, found on page 52-101.

qa_pairs.question: What procedure number covers the reclining mechanism on the left or right front seat?
qa_pairs.answer: Procedure 210 covers the reclining mechanism on left or right front seat remove and install or replace, found on page 52-102.

qa_pairs.question: Which page contains information about back panel removal on front seat backrests?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 52-103 contains procedure 450 for back panel on left or right front seat backrest remove and install.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure reference for rear seat cushion and backrest work?
qa_pairs.answer: 52 20 000 - Rear seat cushion and backrest remove and install, which can be found on page 52-201.
